existing_units.name: Swordsman
existing_units.planned_identity: Keep the generalist and cleave; distinct from Militia bodies and Maceman armor break.

existing_units.name: Archer
existing_units.planned_identity: Keep cheap single-shot ranged support and volley; Longbowman trades tempo for charged shots.

existing_units.name: Shield Knight
existing_units.planned_identity: Add a limited allied projectile interception stance; Lantern Guard remains the durable splash fighter.

existing_units.name: Spearman
existing_units.planned_identity: Keep reach and armor-ignoring thrust; Pikeman specializes in braced charge interception.

existing_units.name: Crossbowman
existing_units.planned_identity: Keep quick precision shots and farthest-target special; Longbowman has a charged opening and poor mobility.

existing_units.name: Cavalry Rider
existing_units.planned_identity: Keep the line charge; Outrider intercepts defensively and Mounted Archer fires while moving.

existing_units.name: Siege Engineer
existing_units.planned_identity: Keep wagon repair and add one temporary repairable bolt emplacement; Runesmith specializes in allied wards and constructed objects.

existing_units.name: Mage
existing_units.planned_identity: Make Arcane Beam pierce a line; Stormcaller owns chained hits between enemies.

existing_units.name: Halberdier
existing_units.planned_identity: Keep melee siege damage and sweep; Wardbreaker removes magical protection rather than physical armor.

existing_units.name: Alchemist
existing_units.planned_identity: Keep direct lobbed splash with a short splash-debuff special; Firepot Thrower owns lasting ground fire. Correct burning-ground lore unless intentionally added.

existing_units.name: Battle Monk
existing_units.planned_identity: Keep a combat aura and periodic area healing; Field Medic is the dedicated single-patient healer.

existing_units.name: War Hound
existing_units.planned_identity: Keep cheapest fast expendable scout; Militia adds two slower bodies at higher total cost.

existing_units.name: Banner Knight
existing_units.planned_identity: Keep nearby offensive aura and rally; Chanter improves ability recovery rather than passive damage.

existing_units.name: Necromancer
existing_units.planned_identity: Implement corpse-token conversion into capped temporary allied Risen; no tokens or resource refunds from summoned bodies.

existing_units.name: Rogue
existing_units.planned_identity: Keep backline targeting and a true next-strike Vanish bonus; Duelist owns defensive melee parries.

existing_units.name: Berserker
existing_units.planned_identity: Keep missing-health damage; implement real attack recovery acceleration for frenzy.

existing_units.name: Lantern Guard
existing_units.planned_identity: Keep splash and toughness; replace duplicated Shield Wall special with a short defensive sweep that protects its own position.

existing_units.name: Ballista Crew
existing_units.planned_identity: Keep mobile structure-hitting bolts; replace duplicated Snipe with a marked armor-piercing siege shot.

existing_units.name: Stormcaller
existing_units.planned_identity: Make ordinary attacks or special chain through a limited number of packed enemies; do not reuse Mage beam.

new_units.name: Militia
new_units.signature: Two fragile levy soldiers deploy together; one card cooldown and one courage payment.
new_units.weakness: Splash attacks punish the pair; weak sustained damage.
new_units.visual: Two kettle helmets and mismatched short spears.

new_units.name: Maceman
new_units.signature: Every third committed hit briefly breaks armor on one target.
new_units.weakness: Short reach and slow windup; vulnerable to rear casters.
new_units.visual: Heavy round mace and dented half-plate.

new_units.name: Field Medic
new_units.signature: Prioritizes one injured ally and channels repeated healing instead of attacking.
new_units.weakness: Needs a protected patient; interruption stops the channel.
new_units.visual: Satchel, white sleeve, folding field staff.

new_units.name: Longbowman
new_units.signature: Charges a powerful straight shot while stationary; loses charge when displaced.
new_units.weakness: Slow opening shot and poor close defense.
new_units.visual: Tall asymmetric bow and salt-blue hood.

new_units.name: Javelin Skirmisher
new_units.signature: Throws once, retreats a short distance, then commits to melee.
new_units.weakness: Limited ammunition and one retreat; not sustained ranged damage.
new_units.visual: Three visible javelins and small round shield.

new_units.name: Quartermaster
new_units.signature: Nearby allied kills earn small courage packets on a shared cooldown.
new_units.weakness: Low damage; no reward from summoned allies or artificial targets.
new_units.visual: Bulky supply backpack and tally board.

new_units.name: Iron Sentinel
new_units.signature: Braces while stationary and redirects a capped part of nearby allies' direct damage to itself.
new_units.weakness: Slow advance; area hazards and blight bypass redirection.
new_units.visual: Wide rectangular shield and broad iron shoulders.

new_units.name: Firepot Thrower
new_units.signature: Lobs pots that leave short-lived burning patches.
new_units.weakness: Slow projectiles; fire-resistant foes and forced movement.
new_units.visual: Clay pots, padded sleeves, furnace-orange straps.

new_units.name: Runesmith
new_units.signature: Places temporary wards on allies; repairs nearby player-built tactical objects.
new_units.weakness: Small ward radius and low personal damage.
new_units.visual: Portable anvil and suspended rune plates.

new_units.name: Flame Adept
new_units.signature: Sweeps a short cone of flame, applying capped burn stacks to clustered enemies.
new_units.weakness: Short range; poor isolated-target damage and fire wards.
new_units.visual: Hand brazier and fan-shaped flame focus.

new_units.name: Plague Doctor
new_units.signature: Cleanses blight and healing reduction from one ally, with modest recovery.
new_units.weakness: Weak raw healing; cannot erase terrain hazards everywhere.
new_units.visual: Beaked mask, censer flask, ivory gloves.

new_units.name: Flagellant
new_units.signature: On death, grants a brief rally to nearby living allies; never triggers from revived or summoned copies.
new_units.weakness: Fragile; deaths consume courage and cannot sustain a free loop.
new_units.visual: Chain flail, bandaged arms, small amber votives.

new_units.name: Paladin
new_units.signature: After protecting a wounded ally, charges one radiant strike and an ally shield.
new_units.weakness: High cost and long support cooldown; spread formations waste protection.
new_units.visual: Sunburst shield, white tabard, short radiant sword.

new_units.name: Pikeman
new_units.signature: Braces against a telegraphed charge and interrupts the first charger reaching its spear tip.
new_units.weakness: Can be flanked; loses brace while moving or pulled.
new_units.visual: Extra-long pike, foot brace, narrow helmet.

new_units.name: Trapper
new_units.signature: Leaves visible snares behind its advance, with at most two active traps.
new_units.weakness: Enemy artillery clears traps; snares do not stop incorporeal foes.
new_units.visual: Coiled wire, stake bundles, compact crossbow.

new_units.name: Earthshaper
new_units.signature: Raises a temporary stone obstacle and sends a slow ground shock through packed enemies.
new_units.weakness: Long cast; mobile backline threats bypass the obstacle.
new_units.visual: Stone gauntlets and stacked slate shoulder plates.

new_units.name: Gravebound Knight
new_units.signature: Returns once after death with reduced health and permanently reduced speed.
new_units.weakness: Corpse denial prevents return; further revival effects cannot reset the charge.
new_units.visual: Cracked armor with a single teal heart-light.

new_units.name: Spirit Keeper
new_units.signature: Stores limited charges from nearby allied deaths and spends them to shield living allies.
new_units.weakness: Needs attrition nearby; no charges from summons or repeated revivals.
new_units.visual: Lantern cage holding three visible spirit beads.

new_units.name: Wardbreaker
new_units.signature: Melee strikes remove temporary magical wards; its special interrupts a channel.
new_units.weakness: Must reach the caster; cannot bypass physical armor.
new_units.visual: Forked rune hammer and broken ward fragments.

new_units.name: Druid
new_units.signature: Grows a small healing grove and a root patch that slows ground enemies.
new_units.weakness: Stationary patches can be avoided or burned away.
new_units.visual: Branch staff, moss cloak, seed satchel.

new_units.name: Frost Witch
new_units.signature: Builds chill on one target; a threshold briefly freezes it, with control resistance afterward.
new_units.weakness: Slow buildup; resistant elites shorten the freeze.
new_units.visual: Ice spindle and sharply pointed pale-blue silhouette.

new_units.name: Sapper Crew
new_units.signature: A protected two-person crew plants a timed charge against a structure or fortified target.
new_units.weakness: Planting can be interrupted; poor ordinary melee defense.
new_units.visual: Demolition barrel between two hooded engineers.

new_units.name: Outrider
new_units.signature: Intercepts the first enemy nearing the wagon, then becomes a fast light melee unit.
new_units.weakness: Only one interception per instance; weak against heavy tanks.
new_units.visual: Lean horse, short saber, rear-facing horn.

new_units.name: Mounted Archer
new_units.signature: Fires while advancing between shots, then makes one evasive sidestep on contact.
new_units.weakness: Lower precision; vulnerable to roots and spear charges.
new_units.visual: Small horse, short recurve bow, fluttering pennant.

new_units.name: Executioner
new_units.signature: Heavy swings finish ordinary enemies below a health threshold; bosses take a capped bonus hit.
new_units.weakness: Long windup; bad against swarms and reflection.
new_units.visual: Broad cleaver and dark half-mask.

new_units.name: Falconer
new_units.signature: A single falcon reveals and marks a distant support enemy for allied focus.
new_units.weakness: The bird does little damage; loses value against simple melee packs.
new_units.visual: Armored glove, hooded bird, feathered shoulder.

new_units.name: Duelist
new_units.signature: Parries one telegraphed melee strike, then ripostes into the same enemy.
new_units.weakness: Projectiles and simultaneous attacks overwhelm the parry.
new_units.visual: Narrow rapier, off-hand dagger, short cape.

new_units.name: Illusionist
new_units.signature: Creates one fragile decoy that redirects eligible enemies for a short window.
new_units.weakness: Area attacks clear the decoy; bosses resist the lure.
new_units.visual: Split mirror focus and translucent duplicate silhouette.

new_units.name: Chanter
new_units.signature: Completes a short chant to advance nearby allies' automatic ability recovery.
new_units.weakness: Interrupted chants give no benefit; does not speed every deployment card.
new_units.visual: Hand bell, prayer strips, tall travel hood.

new_units.name: Trebuchet Crew
new_units.signature: Sets up before launching slow siege stones with a wide impact area.
new_units.weakness: Very poor relocation; backline dives and interrupts stop setup.
new_units.visual: Compact counterweight arm and wheeled timber frame.

new_units.name: Dragon Tamer
new_units.signature: Deploys with one small pyre drake; directs a limited cone attack through a marked pack.
new_units.weakness: Very expensive; losing the tamer removes the drake's command attacks.
new_units.visual: Low drake, iron muzzle, handler's hooked staff.

existing_enemies.name: Rot Hulk
existing_enemies.planned_identity: Retain death blast; use a clearly labeled variant only if enabling enemy collateral damage.

existing_enemies.name: Grave Brute
existing_enemies.planned_identity: Retain the uncomplicated heavy melee body.

existing_enemies.name: Blight Caster
existing_enemies.planned_identity: Retain ordinary ranged pressure; specialized blight belongs to Miasma Priest.

existing_enemies.name: Bone Nest
existing_enemies.planned_identity: Retain two-body death split; split bodies are not corpse-token or reward farms.

existing_enemies.name: Sapper
existing_enemies.planned_identity: Retain wagon rush; correct suicide-bomber lore or add a separately telegraphed one-use strike.

existing_enemies.name: Dread Herald
existing_enemies.planned_identity: Retain passive nearby damage/movement buff; War Drummer uses interruptible attack tempo instead.

existing_enemies.name: Hexer
existing_enemies.planned_identity: Retain global deployment disruption with its recovery window; Null Magister uses a local field.

existing_enemies.name: Bone Juggernaut
existing_enemies.planned_identity: Retain a readable physical tank; adopt explicit armor once counters are taught.

existing_enemies.name: Lich
existing_enemies.planned_identity: Retain periodic simple reinforcements; Bone Cantor requires corpse tokens and channels for an elite.

existing_enemies.name: Mirror Knight
existing_enemies.planned_identity: Retain general direct-damage reflection; Thorn Brute reflects only contact in a visible stance.

existing_enemies.name: Tunneler
existing_enemies.planned_identity: Retain movement behind the rearmost troop; Cliff Stalker selects ranged-primary targets and telegraphs a leap.

existing_enemies.name: Catacomb Giant
existing_enemies.planned_identity: Retain splash melee and three-body death split.

existing_enemies.name: Revenant Captain
existing_enemies.planned_identity: Add a periodic visible escort rally instead of only a different Herald stat profile.

existing_enemies.name: Plague Engine
existing_enemies.planned_identity: Retain heavy artillery; optionally add a short marked blight patch after the status system exists.

new_enemies.name: Grave Rat
new_enemies.signature: Small packs slip around a single isolated blocker.
new_enemies.counter: Use a cheap screen or area damage.
new_enemies.visual: Low rat silhouettes with bone tails.

new_enemies.name: Rustguard
new_enemies.signature: Weak attacks but frontal physical armor; rear or armor-breaking hits expose it.
new_enemies.counter: Maceman, magic, or surround with several bodies.
new_enemies.visual: Rust-red shield held directly forward.

new_enemies.name: Bellringer
new_enemies.signature: Channels a visible bell call that recruits a small pack; interrupting it prevents the call.
new_enemies.counter: Ranged focus or an interrupt.
new_enemies.visual: Large hanging bell and thin skeletal bearer.

new_enemies.name: Highwayman
new_enemies.signature: A living bandit shoots once, retreats, and then draws a knife.
new_enemies.counter: Cheap fast melee; pin it before it retreats.
new_enemies.visual: Crossbow, torn gray scarf, crooked hat.

new_enemies.name: Drowned Harpooner
new_enemies.signature: Telegraphs a harpoon that pulls the foremost allied unit out of formation.
new_enemies.counter: Interrupt, barrier, or displacement protection.
new_enemies.visual: Very long harpoon and trailing rope.

new_enemies.name: Salt Wraith
new_enemies.signature: Briefly phases through a blocker; becomes vulnerable before attacking.
new_enemies.counter: Keep a second defender near ranged troops.
new_enemies.visual: Tattered sailcloth and a hollow blue face.

new_enemies.name: Barnacle Guard
new_enemies.signature: A shell plate absorbs a limited number of direct hits before breaking.
new_enemies.counter: Fast hits, armor break, or a timed heavy follow-up.
new_enemies.visual: Broad shell-covered shoulders and anchor shield.

new_enemies.name: Hookblade Raider
new_enemies.signature: Runs past a moving frontline to attack a nearby support troop; ordinary blockers still stop it.
new_enemies.counter: A held reserve defender or crowd control.
new_enemies.visual: Twin hooks and short dockworker coat.

new_enemies.name: Ash Hound
new_enemies.signature: Pauses with a bright coal glow before one rapid charge.
new_enemies.counter: Pikeman, barrier, or a shot during the windup.
new_enemies.visual: Low coal-black dog with bright jaws.

new_enemies.name: Cinder Spitter
new_enemies.signature: Its arcing shot leaves a short burning patch instead of persistent unavoidable damage.
new_enemies.counter: Spread troops, cleanse burn, or kill the caster.
new_enemies.visual: Furnace pouch in a skeletal rib cage.

new_enemies.name: Furnace Knight
new_enemies.signature: Armor hardens while glowing; cools after its heavy swing.
new_enemies.counter: Burst during cooling or interrupt the windup.
new_enemies.visual: Furnace visor with clearly opening vents.

new_enemies.name: Powder Bandit
new_enemies.signature: Plants a visible powder keg, then retreats; the keg detonates after a delay.
new_enemies.counter: Destroy the keg from range or move the fight.
new_enemies.visual: Powder satchel, stubby torch, gray mask.

new_enemies.name: Plague Leech
new_enemies.signature: Clings to an enemy tank and grants it limited healing; detaches when the host dies.
new_enemies.counter: Area damage or kill the exposed leech during attachment.
new_enemies.visual: Bright leech visibly attached to a larger body.

new_enemies.name: Miasma Priest
new_enemies.signature: Creates a marked cloud that reduces healing and applies capped blight.
new_enemies.counter: Plague Doctor, Purifying Censer, or immediate caster focus.
new_enemies.visual: Long incense staff and green cloth veil.

new_enemies.name: Rot Surgeon
new_enemies.signature: Stops to heal one damaged enemy instead of attacking.
new_enemies.counter: Interrupt or isolate the healer from its patient.
new_enemies.visual: Bone saw, narrow medical apron, dripping vial.

new_enemies.name: Sealbreaker
new_enemies.signature: Channels a lance that strips one temporary ward or shield.
new_enemies.counter: Interrupt, attack from another direction, or use raw health.
new_enemies.visual: Human masked zealot with a forked gray spear.

new_enemies.name: Cliff Stalker
new_enemies.signature: Crouches before leaping onto a ranged-primary unit.
new_enemies.counter: Reserve melee or a trap near the backline.
new_enemies.visual: Bent goatlike legs and hooked foreclaws.

new_enemies.name: Thorn Brute
new_enemies.signature: Reflects melee contact damage while thorns are raised; drops them after swinging.
new_enemies.counter: Ranged damage or attack during its exposed recovery.
new_enemies.visual: Spiked arms that visibly fold down.

new_enemies.name: Briar Witch
new_enemies.signature: Telegraphs a root around one allied troop; damage and cleansing break it early.
new_enemies.counter: Ranged focus or cleanse; controls cannot chain indefinitely.
new_enemies.visual: Crooked branch crown and thorn spool.

new_enemies.name: Avalanche Bearer
new_enemies.signature: Throws a slow stone toward a marked cluster, briefly separating survivors.
new_enemies.counter: Interrupt its lift or deploy away from the mark.
new_enemies.visual: Hunched mountain ogre carrying an angular boulder.

new_enemies.name: Chain Penitent
new_enemies.signature: Tethers one frontline ally, limiting how far it can advance until the chain breaks.
new_enemies.counter: Damage the penitent or sever the tether with a ward-breaking effect.
new_enemies.visual: Dragging iron chain and candle-lined hood.

new_enemies.name: Ossuary Archer
new_enemies.signature: Its slow spine arrow penetrates the first unit and hurts the next.
new_enemies.counter: Spread supports; a shield interceptor absorbs the arrow.
new_enemies.visual: Tall bone bow and quiver of long white spines.

new_enemies.name: Bone Cantor
new_enemies.signature: Consumes nearby enemy corpse tokens to raise one tougher servant after a chant.
new_enemies.counter: Interrupt or deny the corpses.
new_enemies.visual: Jaw-shaped choir mask and floating bone notes.

new_enemies.name: Reliquary Eye
new_enemies.signature: A stationary warded eye opens after releasing a bolt, creating a brief attack window.
new_enemies.counter: Timed damage or Wardbreaker; never requires a single specific unit.
new_enemies.visual: Stone orb with a plainly opening amber iris.

new_enemies.name: Swamp Maw
new_enemies.signature: A visible mound waits before erupting beneath an advancing troop.
new_enemies.counter: A disposable scout or ranged hit on the mound.
new_enemies.visual: Wide toothed puddle and low mud mound.

new_enemies.name: Bog Spore
new_enemies.signature: Bursts into a short blight cloud that also harms nearby enemies.
new_enemies.counter: Kill from range; exploit its position in the enemy pack.
new_enemies.visual: Round fungus sac and unmistakable green spots.

new_enemies.name: Drowned Colossus
new_enemies.signature: Regenerates slowly inside its own marked water patch; lurches out to attack.
new_enemies.counter: Force it out, deny healing, or burst after the lurch.
new_enemies.visual: Water barrel chest and trailing weed skirt.

new_enemies.name: Bloated Eel
new_enemies.signature: Makes one sharp dodge of an incoming projectile before committing to melee.
new_enemies.counter: Fast second shot, splash, or a melee screen.
new_enemies.visual: Sinuous low body with swollen pale gills.

new_enemies.name: Bone Lancer
new_enemies.signature: Winds up a long straight charge that ends on the first solid blocker.
new_enemies.counter: Pikeman, Stone Barricade, or interrupt during the windup.
new_enemies.visual: Dead mount and long crimson lance.

new_enemies.name: Dust Reaver
new_enemies.signature: Alternates a short javelin volley with a vulnerable reload before retreating once.
new_enemies.counter: Advance during reload or pin it with a root.
new_enemies.visual: Layered gray scarves and three javelins.

new_enemies.name: Carrion Banner
new_enemies.signature: Consumes a limited number of enemy corpses to empower its nearby escorts.
new_enemies.counter: Kill the bearer or remove corpse tokens.
new_enemies.visual: Ragged carrion flag with three hanging skulls.

new_enemies.name: War Drummer
new_enemies.signature: Channels a drumbeat that advances nearby enemies' attack recovery.
new_enemies.counter: Interrupt the beat or separate the drummer from its pack.
new_enemies.visual: Large hip drum and short gray mercenary cloak.

new_enemies.name: Shade
new_enemies.signature: Fades during approach, then becomes targetable before its first strike.
new_enemies.counter: Revealing light, traps, or a held rear guard.
new_enemies.visual: Thin black silhouette with bright hands appearing before attack.

new_enemies.name: Mirror Wisp
new_enemies.signature: Creates one damage-free copy that can draw target locks until hit.
new_enemies.counter: Splash or revealing light; the real wisp has a distinct core.
new_enemies.visual: Twin wisps, only one with a solid violet core.

new_enemies.name: Wicker Giant
new_enemies.signature: Resists physical attacks while its wicker shell is intact; burn weakens the shell.
new_enemies.counter: Fireball, Flame Adept, or Firepot Thrower.
new_enemies.visual: Open wicker lattice with a buried ember heart.

new_enemies.name: Dream Weaver
new_enemies.signature: Marks one support troop for sleep; any damage wakes it, and repeated sleep is resisted.
new_enemies.counter: Cleanse, interrupt, or a decoy that draws the cast.
new_enemies.visual: Large hanging moth wings and a glowing spindle.

new_enemies.name: Gate Breaker
new_enemies.signature: Stops to smash a player blocker, causing a small blast behind it; weak against troops away from structures.
new_enemies.counter: Intercept in open ground or damage it during the windup.
new_enemies.visual: Broad ram-shaped skull and heavy two-handed maul.

new_enemies.name: Crown Executioner
new_enemies.signature: A marked heavy swing wounds one target, briefly reducing healing received.
new_enemies.counter: Parry, interrupt, or cleanse the wound.
new_enemies.visual: Gray royal half-cape and massive black cleaver.

new_enemies.name: Null Magister
new_enemies.signature: Places a visible null field that suppresses magical ward and spell effects locally.
new_enemies.counter: Physical attackers, interrupt, or cast outside the field.
new_enemies.visual: Flat gray rune disc and dark academic coat.

new_enemies.name: Soul Standard
new_enemies.signature: Stores one elite enemy's soul and returns it once unless the standard is destroyed.
new_enemies.counter: Kill the standard first or deny the marked corpse.
new_enemies.visual: Tall soul-cage banner with one clearly lit vessel.

new_enemies.name: Ash Pilgrim
new_enemies.signature: A rare non-attacking traveler offers a visible salvage cache after a brief protected passage.
new_enemies.counter: Optional escort decision; no penalty for ignoring it and no reward for killing it.
new_enemies.visual: Tiny bowed traveler carrying a large dim lantern.

existing_relics.name: Hardened Sigil

current.Description: A rune etched by war itself. It sharpens body and spirit equally.

existing_relics.planned_identity: Convert a limited periodic hit to arcane damage; reduce universal stats accordingly.

existing_relics.name: Hardened Crown

current.Description: A circlet forged from the ashes of impossible victories.

existing_relics.planned_identity: Extend the wearer's qualifying temporary buffs, with a duration cap.

existing_relics.name: Hardened Soul

current.Description: The ultimate reward for conquering the impossible. All who wear it are transformed.

existing_relics.planned_identity: Gain a capped personal momentum bonus after qualifying kills; resets on death.

existing_relics.name: Grave Lord's Crown

current.Description: Torn from the Grave Lord's brow by the combined might of the realm.

existing_relics.planned_identity: A qualifying corpse conversion grants one temporary servant, with a strict summon cap.

existing_relics.name: Iron Warden's Heart

current.Description: The molten core of the Iron Warden, still pulsing with forge-heat.

existing_relics.planned_identity: Regenerate a small shield only after a safe pause between attacks.

existing_relics.name: Sovereign's Mantle

current.Description: The cloak of the Dread Sovereign. It radiates dominion.

existing_relics.planned_identity: Periodically rally at most a few nearby living allies.

existing_relics.name: Plague Censer

current.Description: The Archon's purified censer, now a blessing instead of a curse.

existing_relics.planned_identity: A completed unit ability cleanses one nearby blighted ally on a cooldown.

existing_relics.name: Tower Sentinel's Ward

current.Description: Awarded for reaching floor 25. A ward that steadies the bearer through endless ascent.

existing_relics.planned_identity: A battle-start ward protects against the first marked hazard; retain broad usefulness outside Tower.

existing_relics.name: Ascendant's Signet

current.Description: Awarded for reaching floor 50. A ring that hums with the echoes of fallen floors.

existing_relics.planned_identity: Participation in a field objective gives a capped personal momentum bonus.

existing_relics.name: Apex Talisman

current.Description: Awarded for reaching floor 75. A charm forged from the peak of impossible heights.

existing_relics.planned_identity: Improve damage against named elites, with no percentage-health boss damage.

existing_relics.name: Pinnacle Crown

current.Description: Awarded for conquering floor 100. Only the greatest warriors wear this crown.

existing_relics.planned_identity: The first qualifying unit ability repeats once at reduced power; the echo cannot trigger item effects.

new_relics.name: Rampart Seal
new_relics.signature: Creates a small personal shield on deployment.
new_relics.limit: Single shield; no refresh from summons.

new_relics.name: Tower Charm
new_relics.signature: Briefly reduces direct damage while the wearer has remained stationary.
new_relics.limit: Benefit ends when moving.

new_relics.name: Last Wall Token
new_relics.signature: Gains temporary defense on crossing a low-health threshold.
new_relics.limit: Once per deployment; healing cannot repeatedly retrigger it.

new_relics.name: Iron Prayer
new_relics.signature: Every fourth melee hit restores a little of the wearer's health.
new_relics.limit: No healing from structures or artificial targets.

new_relics.name: Sentinel Buckle
new_relics.signature: Grants a ward after successfully intercepting a charge.
new_relics.limit: Only genuine intercepts qualify; shared internal cooldown.

new_relics.name: Oathbound Chain
new_relics.signature: Shares a capped portion of received healing with the nearest injured ally.
new_relics.limit: Shared healing cannot generate another share.

new_relics.name: Farwatch Lens
new_relics.signature: Increases shot damage with distance up to a modest cap.
new_relics.limit: No bonus at close range.

new_relics.name: Windstring
new_relics.signature: Shortens the wearer's first shot windup after deployment.
new_relics.limit: One activation per deployment.

new_relics.name: Falcon Feather
new_relics.signature: The first hit marks one target for a short allied focus bonus.
new_relics.limit: One mark per wearer; marks do not multiply.

new_relics.name: Huntsman's Knot
new_relics.signature: Boosts damage against an enemy isolated from its allies.
new_relics.limit: No benefit in dense packs.

new_relics.name: Trailfinder Boots
new_relics.signature: A qualifying kill grants a brief movement burst.
new_relics.limit: Cooldown prevents permanent acceleration.

new_relics.name: Twinbolt Clasp
new_relics.signature: Every fifth ordinary projectile releases a weaker second bolt.
new_relics.limit: Extra bolts cannot trigger themselves or duplicate summons.

new_relics.name: Breach Writ
new_relics.signature: The wearer's first structure strike briefly exposes that structure to allied siege damage.
new_relics.limit: One exposure per structure; cannot make non-siege shots hit bases.

new_relics.name: Demolition Rune
new_relics.signature: Deals a small secondary blast when the wearer destroys a tactical blocker.
new_relics.limit: No trigger from timed expiration or friendly dismantling.

new_relics.name: Counterweight
new_relics.signature: Every third artillery shot has a larger impact area and a longer windup.
new_relics.limit: Artillery only; no attack-speed stacking shortcut.

new_relics.name: Gateward Medallion
new_relics.signature: Reduces damage received from marked siege attacks.
new_relics.limit: No protection against ordinary melee or blight.

new_relics.name: Sapper's Fuse
new_relics.signature: Leaves one short-fuse bomb when the wearer dies.
new_relics.limit: Once per instance; revived deaths do not repeat it.

new_relics.name: Chain Hoist Charm
new_relics.signature: Accelerates a siege unit's advance until its first committed attack.
new_relics.limit: Bonus ends permanently after setup or attack begins.

new_relics.name: Cinder Ring
new_relics.signature: Adds a small burn to a periodic successful hit.
new_relics.limit: Burn stacks are capped and never trigger further on-hit effects.

new_relics.name: Ashen Rosary
new_relics.signature: Deals bonus damage to burning targets.
new_relics.limit: Needs another reliable source of burn.

new_relics.name: Coalglass Vial
new_relics.signature: Extends burns created by the wearer.
new_relics.limit: Does not extend allied burns or control durations.

new_relics.name: Fireward Clasp
new_relics.signature: Reduces received burn damage and shortens afterburn.
new_relics.limit: Does not block direct physical damage.

new_relics.name: Phoenix Ember
new_relics.signature: The wearer returns once with low health after a short death delay.
new_relics.limit: Shares the one-revival limit; corpse denial counters it.

new_relics.name: Hearthstone
new_relics.signature: On deployment, extinguishes burn on a small number of nearby allies.
new_relics.limit: No global hazard removal or repeated aura cleansing.

new_relics.name: Rime Needle
new_relics.signature: Every fourth hit applies a brief chill.
new_relics.limit: Control buildup obeys the target's resistance window.

new_relics.name: Winter Ribbon
new_relics.signature: Deals bonus damage to chilled or rooted targets.
new_relics.limit: No bonus against a merely slow-moving unit with no status.

new_relics.name: Hoarfrost Medal
new_relics.signature: Grants a small shield when the wearer is rooted or slept.
new_relics.limit: Shield has a long cooldown and does not remove control.

new_relics.name: Icebound Hourglass
new_relics.signature: A completed unit ability chills its primary target.
new_relics.limit: Area and summon abilities do not multiply triggers.

new_relics.name: Glacial Band
new_relics.signature: After the wearer heals an ally, its next attack creates a small chill burst.
new_relics.limit: Cooldown; shared healing does not trigger it.

new_relics.name: Thawstone
new_relics.signature: Periodically removes one root or chill from the wearer.
new_relics.limit: Does not cleanse blight, wounds, or hostile terrain.

new_relics.name: Mercy Bell
new_relics.signature: Improves the wearer's direct healing of allies at low health.
new_relics.limit: No effect on lifesteal or terrain healing.

new_relics.name: Field Surgeon's Badge
new_relics.signature: Healing another ally briefly protects the wearer.
new_relics.limit: Protection refreshes up to a cap, without stacking.

new_relics.name: Bloodroot Pendant
new_relics.signature: Heals a small portion of direct damage dealt.
new_relics.limit: No lifesteal from structures, damage-over-time, or summons.

new_relics.name: Springwater Charm
new_relics.signature: On deployment, cleanses one blight or wound from the nearest affected ally.
new_relics.limit: One target; control effects remain.

new_relics.name: Mender's Thread
new_relics.signature: Converts limited direct overhealing into a temporary shield.
new_relics.limit: Shield cap; shields do not count as healing.

new_relics.name: Second Breath Seal
new_relics.signature: Survives one lethal direct hit at one health.
new_relics.limit: Once per battle per wearer; damage-over-time can still finish it.

new_relics.name: Nightveil Brooch
new_relics.signature: The wearer begins briefly concealed until it attacks.
new_relics.limit: Revealing effects and area damage still work.

new_relics.name: Assassin's Token
new_relics.signature: The first strike against a newly selected enemy gains a small bonus.
new_relics.limit: Cooldown prevents target-lock manipulation.

new_relics.name: Grave Silk
new_relics.signature: A qualifying kill seals that corpse against enemy resurrection.
new_relics.limit: Does not prevent authored split-on-death bodies already released.

new_relics.name: Umbral Coin
new_relics.signature: A qualifying elite kill returns a small amount of courage.
new_relics.limit: Per-wearer cooldown; no rewards from player-made targets.

new_relics.name: Phantom Bell
new_relics.signature: After receiving a direct heal, briefly reduces reflected damage received.
new_relics.limit: Only reflection; does not reduce the original incoming hit.

new_relics.name: Moonstep Anklet
new_relics.signature: After completing several attacks, dodges one incoming projectile.
new_relics.limit: Cooldown and no protection against splash or ground fields.

new_relics.name: Marshal's Signet
new_relics.signature: Deployment briefly buffs a few nearby allies.
new_relics.limit: Duplicate signets refresh rather than multiply the same buff.

new_relics.name: Supply Ledger
new_relics.signature: Returns a small fraction of paid courage after the wearer's first death.
new_relics.limit: Tracks actual paid cost; never rewards summons or repeated revival.

new_relics.name: Banner Ribbon
new_relics.signature: Extends the wearer's existing aura radius.
new_relics.limit: Creates no aura on a unit without one; radius has a cap.

new_relics.name: Captain's Whistle
new_relics.signature: A completed unit ability can interrupt one channel in a small nearby radius.
new_relics.limit: Cooldown; no interruption of unmarked ordinary attacks.

new_relics.name: Caravan Token
new_relics.signature: The wearer's participation in a field objective grants one small supply reward.
new_relics.limit: One reward per objective for the whole squad, not per copy.

new_relics.name: King's Commission
new_relics.signature: Gains a limited personal bonus when supported by a nearby ally from a different squad role.
new_relics.limit: One qualifying partner; no faction-skin requirement.

new_relics.name: Saint's Reliquary
new_relics.signature: On the wearer's first death, releases one pulse of healing for living allies.
new_relics.limit: No revival chain; summoned deaths cannot trigger it.

new_relics.name: Stormglass Prism
new_relics.signature: A periodic direct shot chains a weaker hit to one nearby enemy.
new_relics.limit: Chain cannot recursively chain or retrigger on-hit items.

new_relics.name: Earthbind Idol
new_relics.signature: Stationary defenders become resistant to pulls and forced pushes.
new_relics.limit: No immunity while moving; roots and blight remain.

new_relics.name: Dragonbone Quiver
new_relics.signature: A periodic arrow pierces one target with reduced damage to the next.
new_relics.limit: Arrows only; structure eligibility stays unchanged.

new_relics.name: Emberforge Anvil
new_relics.signature: Heavy melee recovery briefly grants physical armor.
new_relics.limit: Only after a committed heavy hit; no benefit during windup.

new_relics.name: Mirror Shard
new_relics.signature: Reflects a capped fraction of direct melee damage received.
new_relics.limit: Reflected damage cannot reflect again or lifesteal.

new_relics.name: Gravewarden's Key
new_relics.signature: Periodically seals one nearby enemy corpse before a summoner can consume it.
new_relics.limit: Limited charges and radius; no erasing live enemies.

new_relics.name: Tidemaster's Pearl
new_relics.signature: A forced displacement grants a brief movement and attack recovery boost.
new_relics.limit: Long cooldown; allies cannot farm it with their own movement effects.

new_relics.name: Sunfall Spur
new_relics.signature: A charge kill advances the wearer's charge recovery once.
new_relics.limit: Recovery floor and one reward per charge.

new_relics.name: Gloam Lantern
new_relics.signature: Reveals nearby concealed enemies and identifies the real illusion.
new_relics.limit: Small radius; no global reveal or automatic damage.

new_relics.name: Crownroad Charter
new_relics.signature: Completing a supply objective restores a little squad mana.
new_relics.limit: One payout per objective across all copies.

new_relics.name: Hollow Chalice
new_relics.signature: Consumes an enemy corpse token to recover the wearer's health.
new_relics.limit: Competes with friendly summoners; no gain from summoned corpses.

new_relics.name: Royal Execution Writ
new_relics.signature: A periodic finishing strike removes an ordinary low-health target.
new_relics.limit: Bosses and protected elites take capped damage instead.

new_relics.name: Plagueglass Mask
new_relics.signature: Strongly reduces healing penalties from blight and wounds.
new_relics.limit: Does not remove the status or its other damage.

new_relics.name: Runic Capacitor
new_relics.signature: Stores limited charges from player spell casts and spends one on the wearer's next hit.
new_relics.limit: No charge from item procs, copied spells, or refunds.

new_relics.name: Wandering Shrine
new_relics.signature: After standing safely for a short time, emits a small healing field.
new_relics.limit: Field ends when moving; only one per wearer.

new_relics.name: Basilica Hourglass
new_relics.signature: A first lethal hit suspends the wearer briefly; it cannot act until restored with a little health.
new_relics.limit: Uses the same survival/return allowance as other lethal-save items.

new_relics.name: Siegebreaker's Crest
new_relics.signature: Improves damage against explicitly fortified enemies.
new_relics.limit: No universal damage bonus or boss percentage-health burst.

new_relics.name: Lantern of Dawn
new_relics.signature: Prevents one nearby ally's lethal direct hit and spends its battle charge.
new_relics.limit: Shared squad limit; cannot protect another Lantern of Dawn trigger.

existing_spells.Description: Drop an explosive blast that clears clustered enemies.
existing_spells.planned_identity: Immediate enemy-only area damage; the inexpensive fast answer to a cluster.

existing_spells.Description: Restore nearby allies and patch the war wagon hull.
existing_spells.planned_identity: Immediate ally area healing with limited wagon repair; not continuous regeneration.

existing_spells.Description: Burst a choke point and slow a whole enemy pack.
existing_spells.planned_identity: Quick area chill and modest damage; the current runtime uses movement slow, with explicit chill proposed.

existing_spells.Description: Arc high damage through priority ranged or support targets.
existing_spells.planned_identity: Focused burst near the aimed location; true multi-target chain belongs to Chain Lightning.

existing_spells.Description: Ward a lane so allied units absorb less incoming damage.
existing_spells.planned_identity: Temporary group damage reduction; not Aegis Bolt's finite individual shield pool.

existing_spells.Description: Raise a temporary stone wall that blocks enemy advance.
existing_spells.planned_identity: Immediately creates a temporary durable allied blocker; no construction windup.

existing_spells.Description: Rally all deployed units with a burst of attack and speed.
existing_spells.planned_identity: Global brief damage-and-movement rally for deployed allies; attack recovery is a separate stat.

existing_spells.Description: Shake the ground across a wide area dealing damage and slowing enemies.
existing_spells.planned_identity: Broad direct damage and ground slow; a stronger immediate control impact than a prepared root strip.

existing_spells.Description: Turn the toughest enemy in range into a harmless sheep.
existing_spells.planned_identity: Implement a bounded transformation with attack suppression, or rename it to describe the current slow/vulnerability debuff; bosses get a shorter soft-control alternative.

existing_spells.Description: Bring back the last fallen ally at half health.
existing_spells.planned_identity: Restore one eligible fallen ally at partial health while preserving its spent survival/return state in the expanded design.

new_tactical_items.name: Palisade Kit
new_tactical_items.signature: Builds a cheap wooden blocker after a short, interruptible setup.
new_tactical_items.tradeoff: Buys time against rushers; weaker and slower to appear than Stone Barricade.
new_tactical_items.visual: Wooden stakes with a small construction marker.

new_tactical_items.name: Firepot Mine
new_tactical_items.signature: A ground trap explodes on the first enemy and leaves a short burning patch.
new_tactical_items.tradeoff: Area denial; enemies can destroy the visible mine before triggering it.
new_tactical_items.visual: Clay pot with a bright wick.

new_tactical_items.name: Healing Shrine
new_tactical_items.signature: A stationary shrine emits a limited number of healing pulses.
new_tactical_items.tradeoff: Sustained recovery; cannot heal the wagon and can be destroyed.
new_tactical_items.visual: Short wooden shrine with amber lamp.

new_tactical_items.name: Bolt Turret
new_tactical_items.signature: A placed bolt-thrower fires a finite number of ordinary shots.
new_tactical_items.tradeoff: Rear defense; does not attack structures and needs a safe position.
new_tactical_items.visual: Small tripod crossbow with visible bolt rack.

new_tactical_items.name: Supply Crate
new_tactical_items.signature: A crate yields small courage packets while allies hold its immediate area.
new_tactical_items.tradeoff: Trades mana for deployment reserve; enemies can break the crate.
new_tactical_items.visual: Teal-strapped crate and three supply parcels.

new_tactical_items.name: Frost Trap
new_tactical_items.signature: The first enemy triggers a short freeze and consumes the trap.
new_tactical_items.tradeoff: Stops a dangerous advance; control resistance applies to elites.
new_tactical_items.visual: Pale-blue rune plate with a cracked rim.

new_tactical_items.name: Decoy Lantern
new_tactical_items.signature: A placed lantern lures eligible nearby enemies briefly.
new_tactical_items.tradeoff: Protects supports or gathers a pack; bosses resist and area damage destroys it.
new_tactical_items.visual: Amber lamp on a fragile tall stick.

new_tactical_items.name: Smoke Pot
new_tactical_items.signature: A small smoke area breaks enemy target locks and conceals moving allies briefly.
new_tactical_items.tradeoff: Enables retreat or setup; attacks reveal allies and hazards still hurt.
new_tactical_items.visual: Dark clay flask and low gray plume.

new_tactical_items.name: Purifying Censer
new_tactical_items.signature: A temporary field removes one blight or wound per pulse.
new_tactical_items.tradeoff: Allows healing through plague pressure; does not cleanse the entire battlefield.
new_tactical_items.visual: Ivory-and-brass censer with clean white smoke.

new_tactical_items.name: Repair Cache
new_tactical_items.signature: A placed cache near the wagon applies a few repair pulses while protected.
new_tactical_items.tradeoff: Emergency repair; never increases maximum wagon health.
new_tactical_items.visual: Tool box, spare plank, short amber repair sparks.

new_tactical_items.name: Grounding Rod
new_tactical_items.signature: A placed rod interrupts one marked enemy channel in its radius, then burns out.
new_tactical_items.tradeoff: Answers a summoner or null cast; must be positioned before completion.
new_tactical_items.visual: Forked iron stake and blue-white rune.

new_tactical_items.name: War Horn
new_tactical_items.signature: Marks one enemy near the aimed point as a temporary focus target for eligible allies.
new_tactical_items.tradeoff: Prioritizes a healer or commander; never forces units through blockers.
new_tactical_items.visual: Curved brass horn and a clear target pennant.

new_spells.name: Aegis Bolt
new_spells.effect: Give one ally a small temporary shield pool.
new_spells.job: Save a fragile specialist before a heavy hit.
new_spells.tradeoff: One target; does not protect the wagon or grant permanent defense.
new_spells.visual: A narrow amber bolt resolves into a small hexagonal shield.
new_spells.limits: Shield amount and duration cap; separate from Barrier Ward's group damage reduction.

new_spells.name: Radiant Rebuke
new_spells.effect: Interrupt a marked channel and deal modest direct damage.
new_spells.job: Stop Bellringer, a healer, or a marked charge windup.
new_spells.tradeoff: Poor raw damage; ordinary attacks are not channels.
new_spells.visual: An ivory hand-shaped flash snaps the enemy's cast glyph.
new_spells.limits: Boss disruption obeys an immunity window; does not cancel entire scripted phases.

new_spells.name: Tidal Push
new_spells.effect: Push affected enemies a short distance toward their stronghold.
new_spells.job: Separate a support pack or relieve pressure near the wagon.
new_spells.tradeoff: No large damage; displacement-resistant enemies move less.
new_spells.visual: A low blue crest travels along the lane in the chosen direction.
new_spells.limits: Push distance and affected-body count cap; never pushes through map bounds or teleports behind bases.

new_spells.name: Anchor Hex
new_spells.effect: Temporarily prevent special leap, burrow, phase, or charge movement.
new_spells.job: Keep a Tunneler or Cliff Stalker in the frontline.
new_spells.tradeoff: Normal walking and attacks continue; it is not a full stun.
new_spells.visual: A ghostly chain and anchor settle around the target's feet.
new_spells.limits: Applies before the movement commitment; cannot undo a leap already resolved. Bosses resist repeated applications.

new_spells.name: Molten Brand
new_spells.effect: Briefly soften physical armor and apply a small burn.
new_spells.job: Open Rustguard, Bone Juggernaut, or a fortified enemy for physical attackers.
new_spells.tradeoff: Less valuable against unarmored targets or magical wards.
new_spells.visual: An orange brand traces a crack across armor plates.
new_spells.limits: Armor reduction has a floor and does not stack with copies; cannot target the stronghold.

new_spells.name: Meteor
new_spells.effect: After a visible delay, deal strong area damage and leave a brief fire patch.
new_spells.job: Punish a committed dense pack or stationary caster formation.
new_spells.tradeoff: High mana cost; mobile enemies may leave the warning area.
new_spells.visual: An amber ground mark precedes one fiery stone and a short ember field.
new_spells.limits: One impact; burn stacks are capped. Cannot damage structures or skip a boss vulnerability state.

new_spells.name: Purifying Light
new_spells.effect: Instantly remove blight, wounds, and burn from a few allies, with a small heal.
new_spells.job: Restore healing effectiveness during Miasma Priest or Crown Executioner pressure.
new_spells.tradeoff: No cleanse of root, sleep, or hostile terrain; modest healing.
new_spells.visual: A clean ivory pulse peels dark motes away from affected troops.
new_spells.limits: Cleanses existing statuses once; grants no ongoing immunity. Distinct from Purifying Censer's placed pulses.

new_spells.name: Withering Seal
new_spells.effect: Reduce healing received and ward regeneration for a short window.
new_spells.job: Limit Rot Surgeon support or a regenerating colossus.
new_spells.tradeoff: Low direct damage; does not strip an existing shield or stop the stronghold's repair.
new_spells.visual: A black-and-green broken ring closes around a healing sigil.
new_spells.limits: Boss reduction is smaller; repeated casts refresh within a cap rather than multiply.

new_spells.name: Gale Step
new_spells.target: One ally and a short destination
new_spells.effect: Move one allied troop a short distance along the battle band.
new_spells.job: Rescue a caster from a warning area or reposition a slow crew.
new_spells.tradeoff: No damage; interrupted setup must begin again, and committed melee cannot instantly jump to a new target.
new_spells.visual: A teal ribbon traces the allowed short movement path.
new_spells.limits: Valid destination stays in the band; invalid placement spends nothing. Movement does not reset cooldowns or create a free attack.

new_spells.name: Gravitation Well
new_spells.effect: Briefly draw eligible enemies toward a marked center without changing their target allegiance.
new_spells.job: Gather a spread pack for Alchemist, Stormcaller, or Meteor.
new_spells.tradeoff: No lure and no damage by itself; heavy enemies move less.
new_spells.visual: A low violet spiral with a plainly bounded pull area.
new_spells.limits: Limited pull force, duration, and body count. No overlap multiplier or permanent trap.

new_spells.name: Soul Harvest
new_spells.target: An area containing eligible enemy corpse tokens
new_spells.effect: Consume up to three existing corpse tokens to recover mana.
new_spells.job: Trade potential allied summons for another utility cast.
new_spells.tradeoff: Needs corpses and an initial payment; empty casts are canceled for free.
new_spells.visual: Up to three pale spirit threads flow toward the caravan meter.
new_spells.limits: Prototype refund is capped at 10 mana before the 4-mana cost, for at most +6 net; only consumes each token once. No tokens from summons or split bodies, no proc-generated extra refund.

new_spells.name: Consecrated Ground
new_spells.effect: Prevent hostile use of corpse tokens in the area for a short window.
new_spells.job: Deny Bone Cantor or Soul Standard while allies keep advancing.
new_spells.tradeoff: No damage or healing; friendly conversion can still consume those tokens.
new_spells.visual: An ivory-and-amber ring of low candle marks outlines the ground.
new_spells.limits: Tokens are protected, not copied or refunded; sealing ends with the field. Live enemies and already-raised bodies are unaffected.

new_spells.name: Verdant Renewal
new_spells.effect: Attach a short regeneration effect that follows its recipient.
new_spells.job: Sustain a mobile ally or soften damage-over-time attrition.
new_spells.tradeoff: Slow recovery cannot save an ally from immediate lethal burst; wounds reduce it.
new_spells.visual: A small vine ribbon coils around the target and releases green healing sparks.
new_spells.limits: Refreshes one regeneration effect rather than stacking many; cannot heal the wagon or restore dead troops.

new_spells.name: Bramble Snare
new_spells.effect: Create visible roots that briefly bind a limited number of crossing enemies.
new_spells.job: Delay a fresh rush after the frontline has already passed.
new_spells.tradeoff: Rooted enemies can still attack; ranged threats need another answer.
new_spells.visual: Three thorn knots grow across a short strip of the lane.
new_spells.limits: At most three root activations, then the strip expires. Boss control is shorter and repeated roots are resisted.

new_spells.name: Chain Lightning
new_spells.target: One enemy and nearby secondary targets
new_spells.effect: Strike the primary target and jump to up to three different nearby enemies with falling damage.
new_spells.job: Hit support behind a staggered pack without requiring one tight impact cluster.
new_spells.tradeoff: Weak against one isolated enemy; chain fails across large gaps.
new_spells.visual: A bright branching arc traces each distinct target in sequence.
new_spells.limits: At most four unique targets; no repeated target, proc recursion, reflection chain, or structure hit.

new_spells.name: Rallying Advance
new_spells.effect: Remove root or movement slow and briefly boost movement with displacement resistance.
new_spells.job: Carry a vulnerable formation through a pull or rooting threat.
new_spells.tradeoff: No attack-damage boost and no cleanse of sleep, blight, or wounds.
new_spells.visual: Amber pennant trails appear low behind the affected troops.
new_spells.limits: Movement only; does not speed attack recovery, card preparation, or siege setup. Distinct from War Cry's offensive buff.

new_spells.name: Revealing Flare
new_spells.effect: Reveal concealed enemies and identify the genuine body among illusions.
new_spells.job: Expose Shade or Mirror Wisp without recruiting a reveal specialist.
new_spells.tradeoff: No direct damage; a short local window rather than global detection.
new_spells.visual: A white-gold flare hangs briefly above a bounded ground glow.
new_spells.limits: Does not bypass invulnerability, wards, or boss vulnerability cycles; revealed illusions remain until hit or expired.

new_spells.name: Mirror Ward
new_spells.effect: Deflect a limited number of direct projectiles back toward their origin at reduced damage.
new_spells.job: Protect a backline specialist from hostile archers or artillery's direct bolt.
new_spells.tradeoff: Melee, splash, and ground fields bypass the ward.
new_spells.visual: Two small silver panes orbit the selected ally and shatter on use.
new_spells.limits: Prototype cap of two eligible deflections; no re-reflection, new on-hit proc, or base damage from returned shots.

new_spells.name: Banish
new_spells.effect: Remove a limited number of temporary enemy summons or illusions; natural enemies lose one removable ward instead.
new_spells.job: Clear ritual-made screens or expose a warded caster.
new_spells.tradeoff: Cannot delete natural elites, bosses, or hostile structures.
new_spells.visual: An ivory doorway closes behind up to three fading silhouettes.
new_spells.limits: At most three summoned bodies or removable wards; no kill loot, corpse creation, or percentage-health damage from banishment.

new_spells.name: Royal Edict
new_spells.effect: Briefly suppress eligible enemy special abilities and command auras.
new_spells.job: Open a window against layered Herald, Hexer, or caster support.
new_spells.tradeoff: Enemies keep their ordinary attacks and movement; cast cost is high.
new_spells.visual: A royal seal flashes above the area as enemy aura glyphs dim.
new_spells.limits: Bosses receive only a short disruption to marked channels, never a whole-phase cancellation. Does not erase placed hazards or grant permanent silence.
